'''Sylvie Paycha''' (born 27 March 1960 in [[Neuilly-sur-Seine]]) is a French [[mathematician]] and [[mathematical physics|mathematical physicist]] working in [[operator theory]] as a professor at the [[University of Potsdam]].<ref>[https://www.math.uni-potsdam.de/professuren/analysis/personen/prof-dr-sylvie-paycha/ Faculty profile], [[University of Potsdam]], retrieved 2017-06-29</ref>
She has chaired both European Women in Mathematics and [[L'association femmes et mathématiques]].<ref>[https://www.mathunion.org/cwm/people/gallery/sylvie-paycha Sylvie Paycha], [[International Mathematical Union]] Committee for Women in Mathematics, retrieved 2025-08-28</ref>

==Education==
She completed her PhD thesis at the [[University of Bochum]], Germany in 1988.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.europeanwomeninmaths.org/women-in-math/portrait/sylvie-paycha|title=Sylvie Paycha|publisher=European Women in Mathematics|accessdate=28 January 2017|archive-date=2 February 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170202062454/http://www.europeanwomeninmaths.org/women-in-math/portrait/sylvie-paycha|url-status=dead}}</ref>
Her doctoral advisor was [[Sergio Albeverio]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=146589}}</ref>
